decision.alternative_scope: Account-wide; would also affect older campaigns if resumed. Does not certify manual control over all generated copy/media.
decision.reason_for_no_change: No incorrect generated destination or claim was observed. No paid experiment is active. A global opt-out has an unquantified visibility/engagement tradeoff and is not a demonstrated repair.
decision.next_independent_trigger: A qualified launch decision requiring fixed extra destinations, or native evidence of a wrong-language, wrong-destination or unsupported automatic asset. Prepare an exact targeted decision then; do not repeat unchanged empty grids.
decision.dependent_next_action: Resume the supported standard UET consent repair when the pending support-contact question is answered or a supported publisher/access change supplies a new path. Then verify genuine purchase acceptance.
